itemdesc-temporalpowder: Unstable dust from gears. Decays in 3 days.
itemdesc-temporaloil: Energy fluid for rune bowls. Drinking restores 5% stability per litre.
blockdesc-runeglass-normal: Arcane conductor made of quartz and powder for 4x4 rune carving.
blockdesc-runebowl: Capacity: 1 L. Powers up to 3 blocks below and siphons oil from nearby barrels and buckets within 5 m.
